title: Carly's dashboard: re-choose the layout
question: Three new compact layouts built to cut scrolling, plus the earlier three (Grouped Sections is today's build). Pick one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Three Doors
options.lineage: Banking app home: one line per account, tap to open
options.thesis: The whole screen fits without scrolling: one line each for Needs you, Today and Hours; each opens its own sheet.
options.viewport: Greeting; black Today pass (2 rows, compact); 'Needs you · 7' summary with the oldest 3 items as one-liners and 'See all 7'; 'Fortnight hours · 16h 44m · Export' as one row. Everything fits one phone screen.
options.risk: One extra tap to reach the full list; the summary must pick the right 3 items.

options.label: Now / Later
options.thesis: Only what matters tonight is open; everything older or later sits folded in one 'Later' line.
options.viewport: Greeting; Today strip (one line per person); 'Now' with tonight's extra-time request and today's flag as compact rows; 'Later · 5' folded (swap next week, older flags, supplies); Hours as one link row.
options.risk: Carly must trust the sort; old flags can sit in 'Later' too long.

options.label: Today Strip + Compact List
options.lineage: Wallet cards carousel above a dense inbox
options.thesis: Today's shifts slide sideways as small passes at the top; below, every to-do is one line and opens a sheet to act.
options.viewport: Greeting; a row of small black passes (Ana Done, Maria On shift) you can swipe; 'Needs you · 7' as one-line rows with type icons; Hours as a single row at the bottom.
options.risk: Approving needs a tap into the sheet (2 taps instead of 1).

options.label: Review Queue (earlier)
options.thesis: Work through what needs Carly one card at a time, with Decline / Approve, then the next.
options.viewport: 'Needs you · 1 of 7' with one big card; next-up peek; Today below.
options.risk: Fast for approvals, slower to scan everything.

options.label: One List, Filters (earlier)
options.thesis: Everything in one list with chips for Requests, Flags and Supplies.
options.viewport: Chips All 7 · Requests 2 · Flags 4 · Supplies 1; rows with inline Approve/Decline; Today and Export at the bottom.
options.risk: Long mixed list; Today still at the bottom.

options.label: Grouped Sections (current build)
options.thesis: Requests, Flags, Supplies sections with counts, then Today and Hours.
options.viewport: What's built now: tall request rows with inline buttons; Today and Hours far down on a phone.
options.risk: The scrolling you want to fix.
